tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every portal screen, admin and student.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, the top bar and form fields.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, Kanban column wells, calendar off-hours, code and link fields.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, cards and panels. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes and toggles (3.3:1+ on every surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells beyond the first column, descriptions, meta lines. On all three surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions and timestamps on all three surfaces (5.1:1+ light, 5.7:1+ dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab underline, selected states, links and the focus ring. Text in primary reads on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Dark in the dark theme because the dark primary is light.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav pill in light areas, info chips and the Course Designer role badge.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft (7.5:1 light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Slate sidebar background in both portals.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected sidebar item fill.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar item labels and icons on nav and nav-active.

tokens.name: nav-ink-active
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar item label on nav-active.

tokens.name: nav-accent
tokens.usage: The 3px selection bar and focus ring inside the sidebar (7.4:1 on nav).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and surface-raised: Enrolled, Present, Recording ready.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success chip and banner fill.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface and surface-raised: follow-up due, capacity nearly full, link not published.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning chip and banner fill.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, field errors, Rejected and Absent, and the Live dot. On surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of destructive buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger chip, Live badge and error banner fill.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral chip fill: New, Draft, Scheduled, Unverified.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the mobile sidebar drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Student dashboard greeting and report hero numbers. Once per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the top bar area: Batch Management, Leads.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, Kanban column headers, table group headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default body in the student portal on mobile; long-form lecture content.
styles.sample: Your next class starts in 2 hours.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body, table cells and form values in the admin portal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, chips and nav items.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels and stat card titles, uppercase.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Lecture times, dates and IDs in tables and calendars. Tabular figures.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Live-class countdown on the student card.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat card values on dashboards and reports.

spacing.note: 8px grid. space-0-5 is the only half step, for icon gaps and chip padding.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gap, table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards, page gutter on mobile is space-2.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state and auth-screen vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top bar height and auth card offset.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips' inner elements, calendar events.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, Kanban cards, table containers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the live-class card, auth card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips, avatars, toggles, the Live dot.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and Kanban cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dragged Kanban card, dropdown menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile sidebar drawer.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed (icon-only) sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects in the admin portal.

tokens.name: control-height-touch
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs in the student portal and on screens under 768px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of admin page content.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of lecture content and materials text.

tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, date pickers.
